text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a quick shower. After a healthy breakfast, I check my emails and plan the day. I begin work at nine and follow a regular schedule with short breaks. In the afternoon, I exercise for about thirty minutes, either running or doing yoga. In the evening, I cook dinner, relax with a book, and go to bed before eleven. Staying consistent with this routine helps me feel energetic, focused, and calm every day.
